title: Unit Transfer Terms Schedule: Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
A Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement may be moved to another unit at the same facility on the transfer terms of the class of the unit being left.

| Unit class | Transfer fee (class of the unit being left) | Transfers per rolling 12 months | Days the old unit may still be used |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | $25.00 | 2 | 3 calendar days |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | $25.00 | 2 | 3 calendar days |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | $25.00 | 2 | 3 calendar days |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | $25.00 | 2 | 3 calendar days |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | $0.00 (no fee) | 2 | 5 calendar days |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | $0.00 (no fee) | 2 | 5 calendar days |

## Terms common to all six classes

- **Rent on the new unit:** the posted street rate of the new unit.
- **Rate clock:** a transfer counts as a rent change for the rate-increase interval in every class.

## Definitions

- **Transfer fee** — the fee for transferring the agreement to another unit at the same facility, in US dollars.
- **Transfers per rolling 12 months** — unit transfers allowed per rental agreement in any rolling 365-day window.
- **Days the old unit may still be used** — calendar days after the transfer date the tenant may keep using the old unit to move goods, without rent on the old unit.

## Points of reading (hypothetical)

- A tenant leaving a Bluegate Climate Plus unit pays the $25.00 transfer fee whatever the class of the unit moved into; a tenant leaving a Bluegate Premier Climate Suite unit pays no transfer fee.
- A transfer completed on 10 June from a Bluegate Interior Standard unit leaves the old unit usable through 13 June, day 3 after the transfer date.
